coverage.note: 1983-01-05 to 1983-12-21. Read whole, first meeting to last. 33 regular meetings and 9 special meetings (site inspections Mar 29, Apr 19, May 31, Jul 26, Oct 18, Oct 25; executive sessions Apr 13 and Jun 15; special meeting Dec 7). Meeting headings repeatedly misprint the year as 1985 (Jan 5, Jan 26, Feb 2, Feb 16, Mar 9, Apr 13, Apr 20, Apr 27, May 11, May 25, Jun 1, Jun 15, Jun 29, Jul 27, Aug 10, Aug 31, Sep 28, Oct 19, Oct 26, Nov 2, Nov 9, Dec 7, Dec 14, Dec 21); the Feb 23 heading prints February 25, 1985, Mar 23 prints March 25, 1985, Mar 30 prints March 50, 1985, Apr 13 prints April 15, 1985, Jul 13 prints July 15, 1985, one Mar 9 page heading prints 1982, the Sep 14 heading prints SEPTEMBER IJL, the Nov 30 heading prints NOVEMBER 50, and the Sep 14 minutes end dated August 31, 1983; all are 1983 meetings on internal evidence. No minutes for Jan 12 or Jan 19, 1983 are in the scan, though Jan 5 set a matter for Jan 12 and the Feb 2 and Mar 30 minutes cite a Jan 19 unanimous vote upholding the Department in 83-006. No other Wednesday is claimed as a missing meeting: no minutes for other Wednesdays appear in the scan and no continuance cites them. Appeal 83-076 (TRADER SAM'S COINS AND STAMPS, 498 Valencia Street) is skipped entirely: the Jun 22, 1983 minutes state the Police Department opposed the secondhand dealer permit because of an associated person's criminal record. Peddler, pushcart, taxicab, jitney, mobile caterer, street artist and sightseeing bus appeals are skipped even when a corner or fixed spot is named (82-279, 82-282, 83-015, 83-040, 83-066, 83-072, 83-081, 83-086, 83-096, 83-097, 83-098, 83-099, 83-100, 83-109, 83-111, 83-127, 83-142, 83-145, 83-146, 83-172, 83-188, 83-190, 83-206, 83-218, 83-269). No rows for the May 25, 1983 items 83-091 (135 Meadowbrook) and 83-124 (1128 Polk Street): a motion to reduce the penalty is printed for each but no vote is printed. Jurisdiction requests with no address are not recorded (Oct 19: Joon Ho Pak, James Holmes Jr., Michael Null, James Frank Fotenos; Oct 26: Michael Null grant). The V-8745 request for clarification of a variance at 2990 Broadway (Oct 19) is correspondence, not a decision, and has no row. Conflicts recorded as printed, never reconciled: 83-169 address 1635 Bush Street (Aug 10) vs 1634 Bush Street (Aug 31); 83-183 address 3683 Twentieth Street (Aug 31) vs 3686 Twentieth Street (Sep 14); 83-125 correspondence (Aug 10) prints 200 Francisco Street vs 165 Francisco Street in the May 25 decision; 83-221 address
